paper_metadata.title: Predictors of seizure control in patients with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME)

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the recruitment setting and inclusion criteria. However, it is a clinic-based series from a single tertiary center, which the authors acknowledge may not represent the full spectrum of JME. There is no information on the number of eligible patients who declined participation, making it difficult to rule out selection bias.
